key.name: bold-text
key.description: On, the VibeOS apps that follow the font settings draw every weight 300 heavier, up to 1000: regular text (400) at 700, medium (500) at 800. Apps that do not follow them yet are always drawn so.

key.name: display-size
key.summary: Display size: the screen's own scale and the step from it
key.description: The first number is the screen's scale at the default display size, in screen pixels per GTK pixel (3 on a phone with 3 pixels to a dp); 0 until Display size has been set. The second is the step picked from it: 0 is the default, -1, -2 and -3 each a size smaller, 1, 2 and 3 each a size larger. The steps are computed from the first number and the screen's size, so the step stays the same choice when the list of scales the compositor offers changes. The size itself is the compositor's scale: this key is what Settings shows and what the session puts back.
